device: iPhone 16 Pro (iPhone17,1) real device, iOS 27.0.1, 402x874 pt @3x, ProMotion; display link 120 Hz (CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone, preferredFrameRateRange 80..120 pref 120)
format: jsonl, one row per line. k=start {t, scene, rec, scale, maxfps, w, h}; k=touch {t, phase 0 began / 1 moved / 3 ended, x, y} (window points, UITouch.timestamp = CACurrentMediaTime clock); k=dl one row per CADisplayLink tick {t = link.timestamp, d = duration when not 1/120} - dl rows are kept only around gestures (0.15 s before touch-down .. 1.1 s after touch-up). Rows other than dl are logged only when a value changed, so a tick with a dl row and no other row means "nothing changed this tick". k=frame = _UILiquidLensView presentation {ctl accessibility id or "tabbar", x, y, w, h (window bbox), bw, bh (bounds), sx, sy (layer scale), lifted, lpp (liftProgress presentation), p_driftX (flex drift presentation), f_driftX, f_scaleX (flex targets), vi_x, vi_vx, vi_ax (_UIVelocityIntegrator position / velocity / acceleration along x)}. Dropped as redundant: p_scaleX/p_scaleY (= sx/sy), f_scaleY, cls (always _UILiquidLensView), view id. Tab bar rows with y ~ 31 are the bar-local one-frame artifact (kept on purpose).
notes: Gestures are XCUITest-synthesized pointer paths (30 Hz path points, delivered to UIKit at 120 Hz). The three seg5 drag files come from a second pass; the first pass used 120 Hz path points, which the device synthesizer replayed in bursts, and was discarded. The 2026-10-03 tab bar recaptures keep only ctl/x/y/w/h/bw/bh/lifted/lpp of the lens rows (no dl rows): they answer when the lens SIZE lags its lift progress (the slow lift) - every selection change from or to the third slot of the 4-tab bar on this phone, whatever its content, duration or history; never on 2, 3 or 5 tabs.
